Keep ADULT 25+ anatomy, original mature face, approximately 7.5-8 heads tall, normal small head, long natural thighs and shins. Match original portrait's head-to-body ratio, torso length, waist, knee and ankle heights. Don't shorten legs to fit layout. Photorealistic 3D digital human rendering, lifelike skin, detailed hair and cloth. No chibi or doll proportions.
 Preserve reference portrait mature adult 25+ face, natural small head, long thighs and shins, about 7.5 head lengths tall. Photorealistic 3D digital human rendering. Preserve identity, face, hairstyle, ornament and exact outfit/footwear. Body and legs cannot shrink in later cells. No chibi or doll anatomy. Accurate connected fingers/wrists. The open box has an EMPTY GREY cavity clearly above its front wall, no toy/object inside, no confetti. 2) Read: both hands physically hold an OPEN BLUE hardcover storybook at waist-to-chest, eyes look down at pages, lips relaxed closed. 3) Turn page: left hand supports the same book at exactly same position, right fingertip physically touches a single curling page, eyes on book. 4) Reading finished: both hands hold the CLOSED same blue book against waist, warm smile looking at viewer. All four figures stand TALL with same straight legs as reference, do not crouch to read. Keep a completely empty horizontal transparent band across y=42% to 58%. Gowns and shoes must NOT TOUCH hair of the next row. All four bodies remain exact same mature scale. Wide horizontal transparent separation between skirts, no extra veil across gutters.
